work_unit: Optional local NeMo Guardrails for document question and answer boundaries

assessment.risk: high: document privacy, prompt-injection handling, and answer integrity
evidence: The Q&A path carries personal document data and invokes external AI providers.
The implementation needs an opt-in NeMo integration, bounded failure behaviour, and source-grounding preservation.
Existing direct lookup and retrieval paths require regression coverage.

outcome.implementation: Optional local input/output NeMo rails, fail-closed errors, citation-term support validation, and relationship-name abstention.
checks: strict mypy passed for 39 source files
outcome.limitations: The local rails are deterministic policy checks; they do not provide general-purpose moderation or semantic truth verification.
